auto_heartbeat.doc:
Keep the current async Temporal Activity heartbeating within the block.

The context manager records a heartbeat immediately, continues at an
interval derived from the Activity heartbeat timeout, and stops before the
block exits. Use it only from an asynchronous Temporal Activity.

Yields:
    Control to the Activity body while automatic heartbeats are active.

invoke_capability.doc:
Ask AgentK Core to resolve and call a capability from a Workflow.

AgentK selects the registered Temporal workflow or activity for
capability_id. This function waits for the target to complete and
deserializes its result as result_type. Workflow targets receive a
cancellation request when their parent closes; Activity targets wait for
cancellation to complete.

Args:
    capability_id: The globally unique ID of the capability to call.
    input: Input passed to the resolved workflow or activity.
    result_type: The Python type used to deserialize the result.

Returns:
    The deserialized capability result.

Artifact.doc:
An artifact produced by a capability.

Attributes:
    type: The kind of artifact, such as an image or video.
    uri: The location of the artifact for downstream consumers.
    description: An optional human-readable summary.
    model: The model that produced the artifact, when applicable.
    params: Optional model or generation parameters.

Capability.doc:
A Temporal workflow or activity published by an AgentK Worker.

The publish method supplies the implementation kind, and the Worker supplies
the task queue. The Worker snapshots and validates this declaration before
it starts.

Attributes:
    id: The globally unique capability ID. Contributor Workers use
        contrib.<owner>.<name>; IDs contain lowercase letters, digits, and
        underscores and are at most 128 characters.
    temporal_type: The registered Temporal workflow or activity type.
    description: A user-facing description of the capability.
    input_schema: The JSON Schema for input. Its top-level type must be
        object.
    output_schema: The JSON Schema for the capability result.
    timeout: The maximum invocation duration. It must contain whole seconds
        and be greater than zero and no more than 24 hours.
    tool: Tool exposure settings, or None when the capability should not be
        presented as a Tool.

Tool.doc:
Settings for exposing a capability as a model-callable Tool.

Attributes:
    description: Text used for Tool selection. None inherits the capability
        description.
    max_attempts: The maximum number of Tool attempts. None or zero leaves
        the value unspecified; negative values are invalid.

current_meta.doc: Return AgentK invocation coordinates for the running workflow, if any.

report_progress.doc:
Record progress for the current AgentK invocation.

The call waits for the progress event to be accepted. AgentK uses step_id to
make retries idempotent within the current invocation. When the Workflow was
not invoked by AgentK, this function does nothing.

Args:
    step_id: The stable identifier for this progress step.
    message: An optional human-readable progress message.
    data: Optional JSON-compatible progress data.

connect_temporal.doc:
Connect to the AgentK Temporal namespace through KESS discovery.

Args:
    data_converter: The Temporal payload converter configuration used by
        workflows and activities.

Returns:
    A Temporal client connected to the AgentK namespace and suitable for an
    AgentK Worker.

Raises:
    RuntimeError: If KESS does not return a Temporal endpoint.

Worker.doc:
A Temporal Worker that publishes selected AgentK capabilities.

Register workflow and activity implementations through the native Temporal
constructor arguments, then call publish_workflow or publish_activity before
running the Worker. Publishing a capability does not register its
implementation.

Running the Worker freezes and validates its capability declarations. The
Worker announces those declarations in the background until it stops;
announcement failures are retried without stopping workflow or activity
processing.

Args:
    client: The Temporal client used by the Worker.
    task_queue: The contributor-owned Temporal task queue. The AgentK core
        task queue cannot be used.
    workflows: Workflow implementations registered with Temporal.
    activities: Activity implementations registered with Temporal.
    **worker_options: Additional native Temporal Worker options.

publish_workflow.doc:
Publish an already registered workflow as an AgentK capability.

Args:
    capability: The public contract for the registered workflow.

Raises:
    RuntimeError: If the Worker has already started and its capability
        declarations have been frozen.

publish_activity.doc:
Publish an already registered activity as an AgentK capability.

Args:
    capability: The public contract for the registered activity.

Raises:
    RuntimeError: If the Worker has already started and its capability
        declarations have been frozen.

run.doc:
Validate, publish, and run the Worker until it is shut down.

Capability publication and KESS endpoint refresh stop when the native
Temporal Worker returns.

shutdown.doc: Stop capability publication before shutting down the Worker.

__aenter__.doc: Validate and freeze capabilities before entering the Worker context.
